title: The Relational-Thermodynamic Map (100-Entry Update) — Philosophy as Empirical Phase Space
summary: A comprehensive mapping of 100+ philosophical traditions onto a unified framework treating relational logic primitives (reflexivity, symmetry, transitivity, antisymmetry, functionality) as thermodynamic properties, yielding a "phase diagram of human rationality." Each philosophy receives a thermodynamic signature, dominant logical primitive, reistic state, and logic topology, enabling prediction of cultural evolution and belief-system error correction. The document demonstrates that meaning operates as manifold flow rather than mere cognitive computation.
